text_en: Now Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, so he did not go, as at other times, to look for omens, but set his face toward the wilderness.
text_cn: 巴郎见祝福以色列，为上主所喜悦，就不再像前几次一样先去探求预示，只转面向旷野。

text_en: Balaam looked up and saw Israel camping tribe by tribe. Then the spirit of God came upon him,
text_cn: 巴郎一举目，看见了按支派扎营的以色列人；那时天主的神降在他身上，

text_en: and he uttered his oracle, saying: “The oracle of Balaam son of Beor, the oracle of the man whose eye is clear,
text_cn: 他遂吟诗说：“贝敖尔的儿子巴郎的神谕，明眼男子的神谕，

text_en: the oracle of one who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, who falls down, but with eyes uncovered:
text_cn: 那听到天主的话，得见全能者的神视，在沉睡中开了神眼的神谕：

text_en: how fair are your tents, O Jacob, your encampments, O Israel!
text_cn: 雅各伯，你的帐幕，何其壮观！以色列，你的居所，何其美好！

text_en: Like palm groves that stretch far away, like gardens beside a river, like aloes that the Lord has planted, like cedar trees beside the waters.
text_cn: 如扩展的棕林，似河畔的花园，像上主栽种的沉香，似临水的香柏。

text_en: Water shall flow from his buckets, and his seed shall have abundant water, his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
text_cn: 英雄由他的后裔而出，他将治理许多民族；他的君王超越阿加格，他的王国必受举扬。

text_en: God who brings him out of Egypt, is like the horns of a wild ox for him; he shall devour the nations that are his foes and break their bones. He shall strike with his arrows.
text_cn: 领他出埃及的天主，为他有如野牛的角。他要吞灭那敌对他的人民，粉碎他们的骨骸，折断他们的箭矢。

text_en: He crouched, he lay down like a lion, and like a lioness; who will rouse him up? Blessed is everyone who blesses you, and cursed is everyone who curses you. ”
text_cn: 他蹲伏卧下有如雄狮，又似母狮；谁敢令他起立？祝福你的，必受祝福；咒骂你的，必受咒骂。”

text_en: Then Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I summoned you to curse my enemies, but instead you have blessed them these three times.
text_cn: 巴拉克对巴郎大发忿怒，拍手向他说：“我请你来是为咒骂我的仇敌；看，你反祝福他们，且已三次。

text_en: Now be off with you! Go home! I said, ‘I will reward you richly, ’ but the Lord has denied you any reward. ”
text_cn: 现在你快回你故乡去！我原想丰富地酬谢你，但是，上主夺去了你的酬报。”

text_en: And Balaam said to Balak, “Did I not tell your messengers whom you sent to me,
text_cn: 巴郎回答巴拉克说：“我不是已对你遣来的使者声明过：

text_en: ‘If Balak should give me his house full of silver and gold, I would not be able to go beyond the word of the Lord , to do either good or bad of my own will; what the Lord says, that is what I will say’?
text_cn: 即使巴拉克给我满屋金银，我也不能违犯上主的命令，任意去行善或作恶，而只能说上主所吩咐的吗？

text_en: So now, I am going to my people; let me advise you what this people will do to your people in days to come. ”
text_cn: 现在，我就要回到我民族那里去；来，让我告诉你这民族日后对你的民族所要做的事。”

text_en: So he uttered his oracle, saying: “The oracle of Balaam son of Beor, the oracle of the man whose eye is clear,
text_cn: 于是他吟诗说：“贝敖尔的儿子巴郎的神谕，明眼男子的神谕，

text_en: the oracle of one who hears the words of God, and knows the knowledge of the Most High, who sees the vision of the Almighty, who falls down, but with his eyes uncovered:
text_cn: 那听到天主的话，深知至高者的思虑，得见全能者的神视，在沉睡中开了神眼的神谕：

text_en: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near— a star shall come out of Jacob, and a scepter shall rise out of Israel; it shall crush the borderlands of Moab, and the territory of all the Shethites.
text_cn: 我看见他，却不是在现在；我望见他，却不是在近处：由雅各伯将出现一颗星，由以色列将兴起一权杖，击碎摩阿布的额角，粉碎舍特一切子民的脑盖。

text_en: Edom will become a possession, Seir a possession of its enemies, while Israel does valiantly.
text_cn: 厄东将成为他的属地，色依尔将成为他的辖境；以色列必行使威权。

text_en: One out of Jacob shall rule, and destroy the survivors of Ir. ”
text_cn: 由雅各伯将出生一位统治仇敌者，他要除灭依尔的遗民。”

text_en: Then he looked on Amalek, and uttered his oracle, saying: “First among the nations was Amalek, but its end is to perish forever. ”
text_cn: 以后他望见阿玛肋克，遂吟诗说：“阿玛肋克原是众民之首，但他的结局是永远的灭亡。”

text_en: Then he looked on the Kenite, and uttered his oracle, saying: “Enduring is your dwelling place, and your nest is set in the rock;
text_cn: 后又望见刻尼人，遂吟诗说：“你的居所固然巩固，你的巢穴纵然建在磐石间；

text_en: yet Kain is destined for burning. How long shall Asshur take you away captive? ”
text_cn: 但刻尼人仍要被毁灭，到何时亚述才将你掳去？”

text_en: Again he uttered his oracle, saying: “Alas, who shall live when God does this?
text_cn: 他又吟诗说：“呜呼！若天主履行此事，谁还能生存！

text_en: But ships shall come from Kittim and shall afflict Asshur and Eber; and he also shall perish forever. ”
text_cn: 从基廷有船来，征服亚述，征服厄贝尔；他们也要永远灭亡。”

text_en: Then Balaam got up and went back to his place, and Balak also went his way.
text_cn: 然后巴郎起身回了本乡；巴拉克也回去了。
